discrepancies.topic: Which districts see each coach type
discrepancies.doc: Each coach type has its own district list. Reads Coach and ELA Coach (non-Reads): D9, D11, D12, D13, D16, D25, D75. ELA Early Childhood Coach: the same plus NY_CBO. Solves Coach/D75 Math Coach and Math Coach (non-Solves/non-D75): D9, D11, D12, D13, D17, D79, D75, NY_CUNY/UA, NY_Transfer.
discrepancies.code: The coach type question appears, with all five options, for NY_D9, NY_D11, NY_D12, NY_D13, NY_D16, NY_D25, NY_D75, NY_Transfer High Schools and NY_CUNY/UA. It is never asked for NY_D79, NY_CBO or D17, so NYC Solves questions can't be reached in D79. (The Master Survey List has NY_D79 and NY_CBO, but no D17.)
discrepancies.suggestion: Confirm the district list for each coach type (this is also Holly's open question about D79). If coach types really differ by district, that needs a per-option rule, which a later version of this spec can add.

discrepancies.doc: Starts with "Please select your name from the drop-down menu" (Coach Name).
discrepancies.code: There is no coach name question. The coach is the signed-in user. Only a short allow-list of testers gets a coach drop-down, for testing.
discrepancies.suggestion: Update the doc to say the coach comes from the sign-in.
